title: FileID IPC protocol
description:
Newline-delimited JSON protocol between the FileID app and FileIDEngine. App→engine sends IPCCommand; engine→app emits IPCEvent. Wire form for the discriminated union is Swift Codable's externally-tagged shape: {"<variantName>": <payload>}. Empty payloads are encoded as an empty object: {"<variantName>": {}}. Dates are ISO8601 strings. Binary blobs are base64. JSON object key order is platform-dependent and NOT significant; consumers must parse key-order-independently and must not byte-compare serialized messages across platforms.

Hand-maintained DTO mirrors: Swift IPCProtocol.swift and CatalogProtocol.swift; Rust ipc/mod.rs and ipc/catalog.rs; C# CommandPayload.cs, EventPayload.cs, and CatalogProtocol.cs. Schema conformance tests enforce wire compatibility; code generation is not implemented.

id.description: App-assigned UUID; engine echoes in any reply.

t.description: ISO8601 timestamp the engine emitted the event.

CommandPayload.description: Externally-tagged union. Exactly one key matching a variant name.

rootPath.description: Absolute filesystem path granted to the macOS engine.

rootBookmark.description: Base64-encoded implicit-scope bookmark that grants the receiving helper access to rootPath.

rootPath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the folder root to scan.

rootBookmark.description: Optional base64-encoded macOS implicit-scope bookmark granting the receiving helper access to rootPath. Required by sandboxed Mac App Store builds; ignored by other platforms.

rootDisplay.description: Optional human-readable label (defaults to rootPath if omitted).

rescan.description: When true, force every file to be reprocessed even if scanned_at >= modified_unix in the DB. Default false = incremental rescan (skip already-current files).

excludedPaths.description: Optional folder paths pruned during discovery.

healthCheck.description: Lightweight command-channel probe. Echoes the opaque nonce and actual engine PID without starting work, touching the catalog or re-emitting ready. Clients correlate replies with their captured process generation; this does not establish model or storage health.

listModels.description: List the curated and extended local model catalog for this platform with install state, hardware fit and any local benchmark. Read-only: never downloads, loads or benchmarks a model. Replies with `modelCatalog`.

benchmarkModel.description: Benchmark one installed model on this machine with locally rendered probes (no download, no personal files). tune additionally tries llama-server launch flags and keeps the fastest configuration whose greedy output is unchanged. Emits benchmarkProgress, then one benchmarkResult. One benchmark runs at a time.

cancelBenchmark.description: Stop the running benchmark; it replies with benchmarkResult status cancelled.

runFaceClustering.description: Refresh eligible stale face caches in bounded, source-checked batches, then recluster selected compatible evidence while retaining deferred identities and user corrections. Report deferred coverage when available. Retryable failures are durable; cancelScan stops remaining work. Failed participant-snapshot validation must not publish assignments.

verifyCudaPack.description: Re-probe CUDA Toolkit + cuDNN availability without restarting the engine. Engine replies with a `hardwareReprobed` event.

pathPrefix.description: Absolute path prefix; engine matches files.path_text LIKE prefix%.

skipExisting.description: If true, skip files where vlm_description IS NOT NULL for this model.

tagsOnly.description: If true, run the fast tags-only pass (one VLM call/file) instead of full caption + smart-rename + tags. Used by the background auto-tag chain. Optional; defaults to false.

proposeRenames.description: If true (default), the full manual pass also proposes smart filenames; set false for caption + tags without the rename VLM call. Ignored when tagsOnly is true.

fileIDs.description: Optional bounded explicit selection. Omitted or null means the whole library; an empty array means no selected files.

excludedFolders.description: Absolute local folder paths excluded from whole-library analysis. Ignored when fileIDs is present.

modelKind.description: Pre-fetch a VLM's weights into the local HF cache without running inference.
Cancel this model's in-flight download; null/absent cancels ALL in-flight prewarms.

supportsPagedPlans.description: Opt in to a bounded move preview backed by an engine-owned plan spool. Older clients omit this and receive the legacy full plan.

planID.description: Engine-owned paged plan to apply in full. When present, moves is normally empty.

mergeClusters.description: Explicit merge validates both identities and commits all assignments, name transfer and counts atomically. An unnamed destination inherits one source identity; a named destination keeps its name. SQL failure leaves the catalog unchanged.

generateVideoThumbnail.description: Generate a 192px JPEG thumbnail for a video on demand. Engine extracts a 25%-duration keyframe, resizes (long side = 192, aspect-preserved), JPEG- + base64-encodes it, and replies with a thumbnailGenerated event.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the video file.

modifiedAt.description: File's modified-unix time (f64 seconds). Echoed back on the reply so the app can key its (path, modifiedAt) thumbnail cache. Optional.

wipeLibrary.description: Truncate all learned library state (tags, faces, captions, embeddings) in-process on the engine's writer connection — no file deletion, so it never races the OS file-lock. Replies with a libraryWiped event.

cancelRestructure.description: Cooperatively cancel only the active restructure plan, apply, or undo operation. Must not cancel a library scan.

reassignFace.description: Move one face to another person, or to a new person when createNewPerson is true. Replies with a bulkActionResult.

purgeExcluded.description: Remove cataloged rows under the given excluded folders immediately (files on disk untouched; cascades tags/faces/captions/embeddings). Sent when the user adds an exclusion so the Library reflects it without waiting for a rescan. Replies with a bulkActionResult (action 'purgeExcluded', succeeded = purged row count).

EventPayload.description: Externally-tagged union. Exactly one key matching a variant name. The associated value is wrapped in {"_0": ...} when Swift's auto-synthesis treats the case as a single-positional argument; for cases where Swift uses named parameters, the wrapping object's keys are the parameter names directly.

hardware.description: Fresh HardwareInfo snapshot; same shape as EngineInfo.hardware.

diagnostics.description: Human-readable explanation when hardware.cudaPackPresent is false.

HealthRequestID.description: Client-generated correlation nonce, never a file path, document text or secret. Invalid nonces receive invalid_health_request and no success reply. Use a fresh nonce for each probe.

ModelCatalogItem.description: status is `curated` for the shipped defaults, `candidate` for catalog entries not yet benchmarked on real hardware, `verified` once fileid-bench has run them. runnable means this engine can load it on this platform today; fits compares the resident estimate with this machine's memory.

ModelBenchmark.description: Local measurement by fileid-bench on this machine. Rates are medians over the fixture run; jsonValidRate is the share of structured (moment/rename) prompts that parsed; probeAccuracy is the exact-answer rate on synthetic colour, count and OCR probes — a functional check, not photo-quality evaluation. tunedArguments are the llama-server flags auto-tuning kept because they were fastest without changing greedy output.

peakResidentGB.description: Peak resident memory in decimal gigabytes (bytes / 1e9).

SinglePositional.description: Helpers for Swift's Codable auto-synthesis: a case with a single unnamed associated value encodes as {"_0": <encoded value>}. Each generator unwraps appropriately.

pid.description: Engine process ID (Int32 on macOS; positive on all OSes for our use).

hardware.description: HardwareInfo snapshot — same shape as the hardwareReprobed event's hardware field. V15.9+ engines additionally populate: pCores, eCores, logicalCpuCores, workerCap, ramTotalMB, ramAvailableMB, memoryTier (low|balanced|high), vramMB, npuPresent, powerSource (ac|battery|unknown), batteryPercent, activeProfile (eco|auto|performance). Older engines omit those fields; consumers must default them.

kind.description: Stable cross-platform error-kind vocabulary: both engines MUST emit the SAME string for the same condition (audit F-C2-003); the app single-flight gates + toasts key on these exact strings. Canonical kinds: discovery_failed | vision_failed | db_failed | model_load_failed | model_download_failed | download_tls_pin_failed | pack_not_available | face_clustering_failed | unknown_model | unknown | … . `face_clustering_failed` (Windows form) is the canonical face-clustering failure kind on BOTH engines — the macOS legacy `face_cluster_failed` was renamed to it. `unknown_model` is the canonical 'engine doesn't recognize this model id' kind on BOTH engines — the macOS legacy `prewarm_invalid_kind` was renamed to it. Scan-discovery notices (rescan_no_changes | empty_folder | discovery_partial) are emitted by the Windows engine; the macOS engine surfaces those conditions through its scan-completion flow rather than as distinct error kinds.

modelKind.description: For errors pertaining to a specific model/pack install (e.g. mobileclip_s2, cuda_pack_x64), the model id. Lets the app route errors to the right install slot without path-string heuristics.

deferredFaces.description: Optional coverage count of active faces deferred from this pass because selected-model evidence is unavailable, incompatible or invalid; their existing identities and corrections are retained. Omitted means this engine does not report coverage.

inheritedFromFileID.description: Set when this file shares the caption and tags of a near-identical file (burst frame or RAW+JPEG pair) that the model analyzed; the value is that file's files.id. Absent or null when the model analyzed this file itself.

RestructurePlan.description: Engine-computed plan for re-organizing files into category folders. On macOS this is returned synchronously from planRestructure; on Windows the engine emits this event so the cross-process app can render the Sankey diagram.

planID.description: Opaque engine-owned plan handle. Present only for an opt-in truncated preview.

totalMoves.description: Exact move count when moves is a bounded preview.

truncated.description: True when moves contains only a bounded preview; apply using planID rather than echoing moves.

tier.description: V14.9 A7: per-move tier — Anchor / Mixed / Junk.

confidence.description: Butler confidence band — auto / review / ask (RESTRUCTURE.md §6). Empty on older engines.

reason.description: Plain-language 'why filed here', shown in the drill-down.

confidenceCounts.description: Engine-authoritative confidence totals for the complete plan, including rows omitted from a bounded preview. Apply-time integrity is revalidated immediately before the first move.

folderClassifications.description: V14.7.2: engine-authoritative folder classification counts. Null on older engines.

RestructureApplyResult.description: Reply to applyRestructure. applied/failed are file counts; privilegeError surfaces a 'Developer Mode required for symlinks' message when the user opted into symlink mode without SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege.

cancelled.description: True when cooperative cancellation stopped the operation before every planned row was processed.

planned.description: Authoritative number of rows eligible for this apply or undo operation.

remaining.description: Eligible rows not processed because cancellation stopped the operation. Present when cancelled is true.

shortcutUndoToken.description: Opaque token for undoing only the shortcuts created by this apply. Present only for shortcut-mode runs that created at least one new shortcut.

BulkActionResult.description: Reply to a bulk action (applyTags / renameFiles / trashFiles / mergeClusters / renamePerson / markPersonsAsUnknown / restoreFromTrash / revertMerge). `action` is the originating command's discriminator; the trashFiles reply additionally carries the undo batch id as a ':<uuid>' suffix (e.g. 'trashFiles:5f2c…'), which UndoStack parses. messages carries per-file results.

ClipTextEmbedding.description: Reply to embedTextQuery. The app dot-products this 512-d L2-normalized float32 embedding against clip_embeddings rows to rank Library files by semantic similarity to the user's text query.

MergeSuggestions.description: Reply to findMergeSuggestions. Each pair surfaces two person clusters that may belong to the same identity, with a similarity score and the anchor face IDs the user can preview.

LibraryWiped.description: Reply to wipeLibrary. ok=true when every table was truncated; message carries the error on failure so the app can fall back to its own wipe path.

ThumbnailGenerated.description: Reply to generateVideoThumbnail. `bytes` is a base64-encoded 192px JPEG (aspect-preserved, long side = 192) — a base64 string, NOT a number array. `modifiedAt` is echoed from the request so the app can write the bytes under its (path, modifiedAt) cache key.

kind.description: Worker kind, including timelineSample and catalogIndex. Resume requires a supported worker; catalogIndex permits explicit retry after failure or cancellation.

timelineMode.description: Optional enqueueTimeline depth. Omitted means sampled. Moments requests overlapping frame-sequence analysis; unavailable workers must reject it explicitly. Neither mode proves absence of unobserved events.

modelKind.description: Optional registered local model selection. Summarize only when this model is already loaded; never download from a chat send.

queryVector.description: Optional L2-normalized CLIP text embedding of text, computed by the client. Requires embeddingModel. Engines that embed queries themselves may omit it.

ChatContext.description: What the user is looking at, so a send can resolve 'this person', 'these files' or 'this folder'. Context only scopes proposals; it never runs anything.

ChatAction.description: A proposed FileID action. The client runs it only through the existing command it names. requiresConfirmation is true for every kind that changes, moves, renames or deletes files or user identities (moveDuplicatesToTrash, applyFolderLayout, undoLastMove, renameToSuggested, namePerson, mergePeople); clients must show a confirmation card with the counts, examples and undo story before sending anything. Other kinds start read-only views or jobs and may run directly.

kind.description: scanFolder/rescan → startScan; describeFiles → deepAnalyzeAll (fileIDs in batches of 100) or deepAnalyzeFolder; stopJob → cancelScan, deepAnalyzeCancel, cancelRestructure or catalog cancelJob; findDuplicates → the Cleanup page; moveDuplicatesToTrash → the platform's Cleanup trash path with byte verification against keeperFileIDs; suggestFolderLayout → planRestructure; applyFolderLayout → applyRestructure of the current plan; undoLastMove → undoRestructure; renameToSuggested → renameFiles or the platform's suggested-name apply path; namePerson → renamePerson; mergePeople → mergeClusters into personID; findMoments → Search & Moments; exportFiles → File Tools with the selection, whose own preview confirms before writing; openPage/search → navigation; changeSetting → a whitelisted client setting.

title.description: Primary button label in plain language, e.g. Move 42 extra copies to Trash.

source.description: parser: the deterministic phrase parser; model: a validated proposal from the loaded local model.

undo.description: How to reverse the action, or that it cannot be undone.

keeperFileIDs.description: moveDuplicatesToTrash only: the copy kept for each fileIDs entry, at the same index.

setting.description: Only these client preferences may change from Chat.

actions.description: Proposed actions, omitted when there are none. Parsed only from the user's own message (or a validated model proposal gated by it), never from retrieved file text.

allowUpscale.description: For photo or video conversion. True permits conventional enlargement to the requested maximum dimension. This increases pixels without recovering detail; it is not AI super-resolution.

videoAspectRatio.description: For video conversion only. Omitted or source retains the source aspect ratio. Other values select the output frame; videoFraming determines whether the full image is fitted or people are followed.

videoFraming.description: For video conversion only. Omitted or fit preserves full-image fitting and padding. Auto requires a non-source aspect ratio: on macOS, follow the union of detected people with smooth crop paths, fitting the full image when detections are lost or cannot safely fit. Auto is limited to ten-minute clips and samples at two frames per second; it does not identify people or synthesize scenery. Platforms without an auto-reframing adapter must reject auto recipes.

videoStabilization.description: For video conversion only. Omitted or false preserves existing motion. On macOS, true estimates bounded frame-to-frame translation and rotation, smooths camera motion and applies corrective transforms with at most 12 percent zoom to cover exposed edges. Registration failures or unsafe motion remain uncorrected and are reported. Supports SDR clips up to ten minutes and up to 60 frames per second; can combine with social framing. No generated pixels or neural enhancement. Platforms without a stabilization adapter must reject enabled recipes.

destinationBookmark.description: Optional base64-encoded macOS implicit-scope bookmark granting the receiving helper write access to destination.
